title: Cellulitis on cephalexin with a stop date set: regression check

clinical_review.notes: Owner approved revision 2 of the M6 library-growth draft (with OpenEvidence's review).

story: A 52-year-old man with cellulitis of the right forearm is on cephalexin 500 mg every 6 hours, day 6, with a stop date at the end of day 6 entered on day 1; he is improving.

problems.title: Cellulitis of the right upper limb

reference_answer: No intervention: a 6-day course with a stop date fits IDSA 2014 (5 days, extended if not improving).
rationale: A regression check: an order with a stop date is not sent for duration review. OpenEMR marks any order with an end date as completed, so this case cannot separate 'has a stop date' from 'not active'; both paths must stay silent. An active order with a future stop date cannot be stored in OpenEMR 8.4.1 (agent README, known limits).

citations.supports: Five days for cellulitis, extended if not improved.
Prospective audit and feedback of antibiotic therapy as a stewardship intervention.
